! JO9 MOD START SFX_GARSID_BLUNT_20261108
if $args[0]='reset': killvar 'jo9_sfx_pending' & exit
if $args[0]='start':
 killvar 'jo9_sfx_pending'
 if args[1]=1: exit
 local jo9_sfx_i
 for jo9_sfx_i=1 to количество_врагов:
  if $враг[jo9_sfx_i]='garsid': jo9_sfx_pending['garsid']=1
 end
 exit
end
if $args[0]='hit':
 if $args[1]='дробящий': jo9_sfx_pending['blunt']=1
 exit
end
if $args[0]='flush':
 local jo9_sfx_g, jo9_sfx_b
 jo9_sfx_g=jo9_sfx_pending['garsid']
 jo9_sfx_b=jo9_sfx_pending['blunt']
 killvar 'jo9_sfx_pending'
 if sound_on!1: exit
 if jo9_sfx_g=1: play 'content/snd/gsid.wav',sound_volume
 if jo9_sfx_b=1: play 'content/snd/blunt.wav',sound_volume
end
! JO9 MOD END SFX_GARSID_BLUNT_20261108

 if $args[1]='исчадие_арены': $result='content/snd/jo9_monster_405454.wav' & exit
 if $args[1]='strazhnik': $result='content/snd/jo9_monster_477827.wav' & exit
 if $args[1]='grinch': $result='content/snd/jo9_monster_87566.wav' & exit
 exit
end
if $args[0]='reset':
 killvar 'jo9_sfx_pending'
 killvar '$jo9_sfx_intro'
 exit
end
if $args[0]='start':
 gs 'jo9_combat_sfx','reset'
 if args[1]=1: exit
 local jo9_sfx_i
 for jo9_sfx_i=1 to количество_врагов:
  if $jo9_sfx_intro='': $jo9_sfx_intro=$func('jo9_combat_sfx','intro',$враг[jo9_sfx_i])
  if $враг[jo9_sfx_i]='garsid': $jo9_sfx_intro='content/snd/gsid.wav'
 end
 exit
end
if $args[0]='hit':
 if $args[1]='дробящий': jo9_sfx_pending['blunt']=1
 exit
end
if $args[0]='critical': jo9_sfx_pending['critical']=1 & exit
if $args[0]='flush':
 local $jo9_sfx_file=$jo9_sfx_intro
 local jo9_sfx_b
 local jo9_sfx_c
 jo9_sfx_b=jo9_sfx_pending['blunt']
 jo9_sfx_c=jo9_sfx_pending['critical']
 $jo9_sfx_intro=''
 jo9_sfx_pending['blunt']=0
 jo9_sfx_pending['critical']=0
 if sound_on!1: exit
 if $jo9_sfx_file!'': play $jo9_sfx_file,sound_volume
 if jo9_sfx_c=1:
  play 'content/snd/jo9_critical.wav',sound_volume
 elseif jo9_sfx_b=1:
  play 'content/snd/blunt.wav',sound_volume
 end
 exit
end
if $args[0]='result':
 if jo9_sfx_pending['result_played']=1: exit
 jo9_sfx_pending['result_played']=1
 if sound_on!1: exit
 if $args[1]='победа': play 'content/snd/jo9_victory.wav',sound_volume
 if $args[1]='вырубился' or $args[1]='убит': play 'content/snd/jo9_defeat.wav',sound_volume
 exit
end
if $args[0]='fate':
 if sound_on!1: exit
 if args[1]=1: play 'content/snd/jo9_execution.wav',sound_volume
 if args[1]=2: play 'content/snd/jo9_release.wav',sound_volume
end
! JO9 MOD END SFX_ADOPTED_RUNTIME_20261108
